entities.summary: Vladimir Nikolayevich Toporov was a Russian philologist associated with the Tartu–Moscow Semiotic School. His wife was Tatyana Elizarenkova. He is also recognized as a prominent Balticist. Vladimir Toporov was a journalists & chroniclers from Moscow (1928-07-05, Moscow–2005-12-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
